data_input: P3 prepared dataset N05-prepared-v1.0 (verify SHA-256 in P3/data/metadata/prepared_manifest.json)

AQ1.success: all consistency checks pass; CIs reported

AQ2.unadjusted: Mann-Whitney U + Cliff's delta (continuous); chi-square + risk difference (binary); Holm correction
AQ2.significant_difference: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND |Cliff's delta| >= 0.147 (small) or |risk difference| >= 0.05
AQ2.first_week_rule: earliest week w in 1..4 where clicks_w AND active_days_w both meet the significance rule
AQ2.adjusted: logistic regression (statsmodels), standardized predictors + module-presentation fixed effects; OR with 95% CI

AQ3.task: binary classification, target_noncompletion, prediction point end of day 28
AQ3.split: fit on train (2013B, 2013J); select model and threshold on validation (2014B); evaluate test (2014J) once

models.M1: simple rule: not submitted TMA1 first, then fewer active days 0-28
models.M2: logistic regression L2 (C=1.0), median impute + log1p counts + standardize, fit on train
models.M3: histogram gradient boosting (max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.1, default depth), fit on train

AQ3.feature_policy: no sensitive attributes, no final_result/date_unregistration, only features <= day 28
secondary_metrics: Recall, Precision, F1 at threshold t*
AQ3.threshold_rule: t* = highest threshold with Recall >= 0.70 on validation
AQ3.selection_rule: primary approach = M2 unless M3 validation PR-AUC exceeds M2 by >= 0.02 (interpretability needed by AQ5)
AQ3.success: test Recall at t* >= 0.70 AND test PR-AUC > PR-AUC of M0 and M1

rules.a: top-k by predicted probability within each module-presentation
rules.b: among p >= t*, order by clicks_change_w1_w4 ascending (largest decline first), top-k
rules.d: pooled top-(2k) across BBB+FFF without per-module quota (compare with per-module quota of a)

AQ4.selection: rule with highest mean Precision@200 on validation 2014B
metrics: scenario: expected students changed = TP x 0.14 (assumption A5/C05)
AQ4.success: Precision@200 >= 0.70 in each module-presentation of test 2014J for the selected rule
AQ4.claim: decision support under capacity; no intervention effect is estimated

AQ5.method: for linear model: contribution_j = coef_j * standardized x_j (exact additive in logit space); top-3 positive contributions -> template sentences; global: permutation importance on validation (PR-AUC drop, 10 repeats)
checks: no sensitive attribute in any explanation
sign consistency with AQ2 direction for top global features
AQ5.success: 100% of students in top-200 lists receive an explanation with >= 2 reasons and all checks pass

metrics: share in top-200 vs share in population
fairness.flag_rule: recall gap > 0.10 between groups of the same attribute -> disclose and discuss (no silent re-tuning)
